record.description: Rank-1 recipe e2000fs_calib_offset_roll (team functions design / spectral_objective / prior_split / native_head / estimate_state / apply_state copied unchanged): DirMO-24 feat30 (21 constant + 24 x 9 lead-varying inputs per 24-lead block, team column order), three multi_output_tree XGBoost 2.1.4 blocks (depth 3, lr 0.03, 900 rounds, PARAMS seed 42 only), spectral loss (weight on observed speed >= 550 km/s + 0.1 pseudo-Huber FFT term), training y forward-filled along target time (team rule), a prior model fit on the training rows with origin + 144 h <= (last training origin - 3 months) that predicts the last training quarter, and a frozen per-lead offset 0.25 x mean residual of that prior over the last 336 calibration rows added to the query forecast, clip 1-3000. What differs from rank 1: the inputs are the team raw-only df with the DirMO lab gap fill (causal last value; solar-wind observations without limit, image columns at most 24 h with img_age_h grown, ENLIL not filled; rank 1 fills every column without limit), as in our DS entry, and block 1 (leads 1-24) of both the prior and the full model is trained without the image-derived columns (the 7 suvi_* areas, img_age_h and the 5 strip_* inputs; 109 inputs instead of 237); leads 25-72 (blocks 2-3) are the rank-1 recipe unchanged, and the offset of every lead comes from its own block's prior. Tail weight 4, no recurrence pull. The offset uses only pre-cutoff training data (the prior model's calibration quarter). Pre-registered in jsy301 DirMO lab plans/post_freeze/01_night_run.md (round NI). Submitted because its team-board dry-run Total S was below 101 (user rule 2026-11-08); lab gate result: fail (round NI seed 42: leads 1-24 -3.6 % with CI99 spanning 0, window signs flip, 400-550 km/s regime worse; closed in the lab). No other board number chose anything in this entry; the arm and its rule were fixed before any dry-run.

data.gap_fill: inputs causal last value along the hourly origin timeline (observations unlimited, images <= 24 h with img_age_h grown by the hours carried, ENLIL none) - the DirMO lab fill as in our DS entry; the team fills every column without limit
data.time_convention: newest input of origin O is the hour labelled O-1h; lead h target is hour O+h
data.training_rows: df fit_F1/fit_F2/fit_F3 (origin + 144 h <= cutoff), hourly origins; origins whose filled targets still have a gap (start of the record) are left out
data.training_y: targets of the fit rows forward-filled along target time (last observed hourly speed, only the fit rows' own targets; team rule); query rows are read without y

hyperparameters.base_score: block mean of the filled training targets (team native_head)

dials.pull: leads 25-72: pred + w (rec27 - pred) after the offset, rec27 = the df's lead-varying rec27 input of the same origin after the fill, NaN -> no pull; then clip 1-3000

hyperparameters.loss: team spectral_objective: weight t on y >= 550 else 1 (normalised to mean 1 per lead), + 0.1 x pseudo-Huber (scale 50) term on the FFT of the 24-lead error; hessian weights + 0.1; t = 4 is the team function
hyperparameters.offset: team estimate_state: 0.25 x mean(filled y - prior) over the last 336 calibration rows per lead; team apply_state: forecast + offset, clip 1-3000
hyperparameters.prior_model: same recipe on reference rows origin + 144 h <= boundary (boundary = last training origin - 3 months), predicting the calibration rows (origins >= boundary)
hyperparameters.strategy: rank-1 e2000fs_calib_offset_roll: DirMO-24 feat30, 3 blocks of 24 leads, multi_output_tree
